# AINative Builder
> AI-powered React component builder with Agent Experience (AX) optimization

## About
AINative Builder is a production-grade AI application builder that generates beautiful, agent-optimized React components and full web applications from natural language prompts. Every generated application includes AX (Agent Experience) optimization, SEO, structured data, and semantic HTML.

## Capabilities
- Generate React/Next.js components from text prompts
- Multi-model support: Claude Sonnet 4, Qwen Coder, Gemma, DeepSeek
- Real-time streaming preview with Sandpack
- AX Standard: 10-point agent accessibility scoring
- Automatic SEO: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD, OpenGraph
- Agent-optimized output with data-agent-* attributes
- Template gallery with 12+ pre-built templates
- Multi-file generation with component splitting
- Design token system for brand customization
- One-click deploy to Vercel, Netlify, Railway

## URLs
- Homepage: https://builder.ainative.studio
- Templates: https://builder.ainative.studio/templates

## API
- Chat Generation: POST /api/chat-ws
- Templates: GET /api/templates
- Preview: GET /api/preview/{id}
- Health: GET /api/health
